"""mindmap_work_history — read the change history of a work item."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mem_mcp.db import tenant_tx
from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._base import BaseTool, ToolContext
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._mindmap_common import resolve_team_id
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._work_item_common import WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput, map_work_item_error
from mem_mcp.mindmap import work_items as work_item_service
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors import WorkflowError


class MindmapWorkHistoryInput(BaseModel):
    """Input for reading a work item's history."""

    map_key: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=64)
    node_id: UUID
    team_id: UUID | None = Field(default=None)


class MindmapWorkHistoryOutput(BaseModel):
    """History entries, oldest first."""

    entries: list[WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput]


class MindmapWorkHistoryTool(BaseTool):
    """Return the ordered change history of a work item, incl. stage/sign-off rows."""

    name: ClassVar[str] = "mindmap_work_history"
    description: ClassVar[str] = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS["mindmap_work_history"]
    required_scope: ClassVar[str] = "memory.read"
    InputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkHistoryInput
    OutputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkHistoryOutput

    async def __call__(self, ctx: ToolContext, inp: BaseModel) -> BaseModel:
        assert isinstance(inp, MindmapWorkHistoryInput)

        async with tenant_tx(ctx.db_pool, ctx.tenant_id) as conn:
            team_id = await resolve_team_id(conn, ctx, inp.team_id)
            try:
                history = await work_item_service.get_work_item_history(
                    conn,
                    tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    team_id=team_id,
                    map_key=inp.map_key,
                    node_id=inp.node_id,
                )
            except (work_item_service.WorkItemError, WorkflowError) as e:
                raise map_work_item_error(e) from e

            # The domain entry omits the workflow columns; fetch them for the same rows.
            stage_rows = await conn.fetch(
                """
                SELECT id, stage_before, stage_after, workflow_id
                FROM work_item_history
                WHERE memory_id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2
                """,
                inp.node_id,
                ctx.tenant_id,
            )
            stages = {r["id"]: r for r in stage_rows}

            entries: list[WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput] = []
            for h in history:
                s = stages.get(h.id)
                entries.append(
                    WorkItemHistoryEntryOutput(
                        id=h.id,
                        change_type=h.change_type,
                        kind_before=h.kind_before,
                        kind_after=h.kind_after,
                        status_before=h.status_before,
                        status_after=h.status_after,
                        assignee_before=h.assignee_before,
                        assignee_after=h.assignee_after,
                        stage_before=s["stage_before"] if s else None,
                        stage_after=s["stage_after"] if s else None,
                        workflow_id=s["workflow_id"] if s else None,
                        actor_id=h.actor_id,
                        channel=h.channel,
                        reason=h.reason,
                        created_at=h.created_at,
                    )
                )
            return MindmapWorkHistoryOutput(entries=entries)
EOF

"""mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs — sign-off requests the caller can still act on."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import ClassVar
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from mem_mcp.db import tenant_tx
from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._base import BaseTool, ToolContext
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._mindmap_common import resolve_team_id
from mem_mcp.mcp.tools._work_item_common import PendingSignoffOutput, map_work_item_error
from mem_mcp.mindmap import work_items as work_item_service
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_errors import WorkflowError
from mem_mcp.mindmap.workflow_reads import list_pending_signoffs_for_user


class MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsInput(BaseModel):
    """Input for listing pending sign-offs."""

    team_id: UUID | None = Field(default=None)


class MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsOutput(BaseModel):
    """Pending sign-off requests eligible for the caller."""

    requests: list[PendingSignoffOutput]


class MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsTool(BaseTool):
    """List sign-off requests the caller may sign (owner/proposer and role-restricted excluded)."""

    name: ClassVar[str] = "mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs"
    description: ClassVar[str] = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS["mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs"]
    required_scope: ClassVar[str] = "memory.read"
    InputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsInput
    OutputModel: ClassVar[type[BaseModel]] = MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsOutput

    async def __call__(self, ctx: ToolContext, inp: BaseModel) -> BaseModel:
        assert isinstance(inp, MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsInput)

        async with tenant_tx(ctx.db_pool, ctx.tenant_id) as conn:
            team_id = await resolve_team_id(conn, ctx, inp.team_id)
            try:
                pending = await list_pending_signoffs_for_user(
                    conn,
                    tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                    team_id=team_id,
                    signatory_tenant_id=ctx.tenant_id,
                )
            except (work_item_service.WorkItemError, WorkflowError) as e:
                raise map_work_item_error(e) from e

            return MindmapWorkflowPendingSignoffsOutput(
                requests=[
                    PendingSignoffOutput(
                        request_id=p.request_id,
                        memory_id=p.memory_id,
                        from_stage=p.from_stage,
                        to_stage=p.to_stage,
                        proposer_tenant_id=p.proposer_tenant_id,
                        reason=p.reason,
                        signoff_min=p.signoff_min,
                        signatory_count=p.signatory_count,
                        remaining=p.remaining,
                        role_restricted=p.role_restricted,
                    )
                    for p in pending
                ]
            )
EOF
